integrity: Algebraic induction and orthogonal orbit counts establish arbitrary n and finite extension fields. The standalone verifier independently recomputes degreewise matrix ranks in finite examples; finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic three; homogeneous quadratic forms only, n>=3. Ungraded tensor decompositions and counts of symmetric quadratic forms are prior standard results; possible coverage by specialized graded tensor literature remains an originality risk. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Graded Jordan strata of quadratic sections of ternary truncated polynomial algebras
